ShortDescription.Value: Unlock Signature buildings, place multiple Unique buildings, and control city-wide and nearby bonuses.

Publish.LongDescription:
# 🏙️ ## Realistic Signature Buildings Fix
**Unlimited buildings without making the economy unrealistic and broken!**
Duplicate Signature buildings stack strong city-wide bonuses, making CS2's economy too easy.
### 1. Control City-wide bonuses: 3 choices
- **Vanilla Stacking:** every copy has normal game bonuses. Want super-easy mode? Keep stacking! - **First Copy Only (mod default):** only one copy of each building contributes city-wide bonuses. More Realistic, 5 building copies no longer has 5x stacked bonuses! - **No City Bonuses:** disable general Signature city-wide bonuses for a bigger challenge.
**City-wide Attractiveness is controlled separately.** Choose First copy only (default), Vanilla stacking, No attractiveness bonus, or Follow city-wide setting.
### 2. Nearby Local Effects — Separate controls! - Keep neighborhood "aoe" benefits w/out stacking multiplying whole city broken bonuses! - Choose **Vanilla, First-Copy Only, or Off** independent of your city-wide bonus setting.
### 3. More Options - You choose! ✅ Allow unlimited unique buildings. ✅ Unlock Signature buildings without meeting their population, zoning, or other progression requirements. I want it NOW! ✅ QoL, Hide mass unlock pop-ups: Stop the Spam when unlocking many Signature buildings at once. Save your click finger! ✅ See Clearly: hide auto infoview overlays when placing Unique buildings, disables colored ground overlay and black-out of buildings! You can still open infoviews manually as needed or disable this toggle [x] in Options menu (was a player request).
### Compatibility - Compatible with **Anarchy**, including its multiple unique setting. - Designed for safe removal: placed copies stay; vanilla bonuses and placement rules return after reload. No Harmony patches. - Combines many features to reduce the need for 3 separate mods.
### Notes - Hover over Options menu rows for tool tips (see the 3rd panel to the right). - Green bonus text in the building info panel stays visible even when this mod limits or disables a bonus. It may not reflect the active effect. - To verify, check the mod Options → Actions → Status to see: how many Signature buildings and extra copies are placed, which general city-wide bonus providers are active or blocked, and the selected Attractiveness rule. For even more detailed calculations and actual city-wide modifier values, use About → Status report to log and open the log file.
